message: You know that one friend who always panics at the slightest hint of smoke? 😅 I remember one time we were making dinner, and she suddenly thought the kitchen was on fire just because I was browning some onions! It made me realize how important it is to have a calm plan for emergencies. So, we laughed it off and came up with an escape plan together. It’s nice to know we can be prepared without losing our heads! How do you keep things chill in a pinch?
